scope: All 102 opportunity cards currently in the repository, plus visa appointment services tracked separately.

statusDefinitions.researched-article: Multi-section original trilingual content checked against official primary source(s)
statusDefinitions.official-labour-evidence: Country/region official labour market reporting, not evidence of individual job offers
statusDefinitions.source-listing-awaiting-detailed-review: Verified source record only; full job eligibility/duties/pay not yet extracted; not a complete article
statusDefinitions.official-booking-source-only: The country-specific official booking instructions are available; no real-time appointment slots verified
statusDefinitions.researched-awaiting-live-verification: Original signed notice and trilingual article researched; site build, deployment and live URL still require explicit verification before counting as published

requirements: Read each individual recruitment PDF or government page, NOT only the listing title
Report salary only if the employer actually publishes it
Mention city, employer, number of positions, real eligibility, diploma, work schedule and deadline exactly as sourced
Separate national shortage statistics and regional forecasts from live jobs and visas
Publish trilingual AR-standard, FR and EN deep articles with source dates and references
Warn about official date conflicts and expiry instead of quietly choosing a convenient date
Keep internal cards within RibhLab and external primary sources in new tabs

cards.title: Administrateur 2ème grade — Statistique / Économie appliquée — HCP (11 postes)
cards.priority: signed-two-page-HCP-notice-rechecked-2026-10-30; pending build/deploy and live trilingual QA
cards.note: Verified original HCP two-page Arabic recruitment notice against official emploi-public listing C44349/26, both checked 30 Oct 2026. Eleven administrators grade 2 scale 11 in Statistics / Applied Economics; assignments HCP central services and regional offices, not eleven named jobs in Rabat. Moroccan citizenship, master/specialized master or equivalent in the relevant specialty, age 18–45 on 1 January 2026; statutory reserved categories described in notice (25% and 7%). Written general paper 3h coefficient 2, specialty paper 3h coefficient 3, oral 15–30 minutes coefficient 3. Mandatory online application at depot.emploi-public.ma no later than 13 Nov 2026 at 16:30; exam 29 Nov 2026 in Rabat or another announced city. Required: application form, diploma/equivalence where relevant, specialty attestation if diploma does not state specialty, national ID, photo CV, employer authorization for civil servants and category-specific supporting documents. No exact salary stated in the notice; scale 11 is not a net-pay quotation. Candidate list published via emploi-public and HCP, appeals by email within 48h. These are primary-source facts; trilingual page live verification remains pending, so do not count as published research.
